description: This file defines the IGrainDirectoryCache interface and some extension methods related to caching grain directory entries within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryCache
classes.description: An interface for caching grain directory entries, allowing addition, removal, lookup, and clearing of cache entries.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryCacheExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to simplify lookup operations on IGrainDirectoryCache instances.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry with a specified version.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by either GrainId or GrainAddress key.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: LookUp
methods.description: Looks up a cache entry by GrainId, returning the result and version if found.

methods.name: LookUp (extension method)
methods.description: Extension method for IGrainDirectoryCache to look up a GrainAddress by GrainId, simplifying the lookup process.
